topology.endpoint_matching: Exact equality of original WGS84 endpoint coordinates; no endpoint snapping

methods.geometry: Original whole NLDI reaches are retained untrimmed. Station locations are separate features.
methods.direction: DM source membership defines downstream scope; exact original endpoints determine a unique path from its origin reach.
methods.position: Hydrolocation is projected only onto its declared COMID, and only when the indexed WQP COMID agrees. A residual over two metres is reported as unresolved.
methods.distance: Approximate spherical geodesic lengths using radius 6,371,008.8 m; local tangent-plane segment projection with interpolated segment length. Distances are geographic network context, not travel time.
methods.measure: Original reachcode and measure are retained verbatim; measure is not substituted for a fraction of COMID geometry length.
methods.coordinates: Original agency station coordinates, NLDI indexed WQP coordinates and NLDI snapped hydrolocations remain separate.
methods.scope: Network relationships and approximate distances do not establish flow, loads, intake concentrations, treatment response or causation.
